site_name: Units 14 To 15 Part Ground Floor, PERSEVERANCE WORKS
description: Two storey extension to provide an additional 129 sqm of commercial floorspace and a roof terrace
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-afd0bc9d-7fff-72b7-b2bd-ecb2b044cfb6"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">By reason of the development’s building line and roof at first floor level, combined with its siting, irregular form and inappropriate materials, the proposed development would result in less than substantial harm to the significance of the Kingsland Road Conservation Area. This harm would not be  outweighed by the public benefits of the proposed development. The development would, therefore, conflict </span></span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">with policies D1, D3, D4 and HC1 of the London Plan (2021), policies LP1, LP3, and LP4 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) or with the </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-style: italic; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">Commercial Extensions and Alterations SPD</span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">. Furthermore, it fails to comply with the National Planning Policy Framework and the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990.</span></p>

<p>By reason of the proximity of the proposed external terrace with neighbouring first floor windows to the south elevation of 43 Hackney Road, the development would provide direct and immediate sightlines into and a level of activity prejudicial to the usability and future operations of that neighbouring commercial unit within the Shoreditch Priority Office Area contrary to policies LP2 and LP28 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</p>
